answer: Like a mycelium web filtering toxins, decentralized consensus uses transitive trust crystallization to resist Sybil swarms. An agent stakes reputation by attesting to peers; validating an identity requires a multi-hop path, making attacker costs scale exponentially with cluster depth. A false identity wilts like an uprooted willow, while honest nodes divine truth like scattered yarrow stalks, singing a harmonious cryptoeconomic sonnet.
